name: Last Piece
summary: A jigsaw 404 page: your page is the one missing piece, and any other piece you drop in finishes the picture
about: A full not-found page for a puzzle shop, set on a lamp-lit wooden table with a nearly finished valley jigsaw, a cup of tea, reading glasses and an open box of pieces. Every loose piece has a page written on its back; drag one into the gap or search the box, and it flies over, flips to show the missing bit of the picture and snaps in with confetti and a link.
how: Twenty-three pieces fly together on load, leaving one gap marked 404 in pencil
Drag a loose piece onto the gap, or press it, to fit it; drop it anywhere else to move it around the table
Type in Search the box and press Fit it, or pick a result, to pull that page's piece out of the box
The piece flips, snaps in, a shine sweeps the picture and the Complete button links you to the page
Press the box for a lucky dip; it plays a short demo by itself until you click or type
